summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ProShares Ultra MidCap400 (MVV) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Mid Cap 400 index. The fund provides daily 2x leveraged exposure to a market-cap weighted index of 400 US mid-cap companies. MVV was launched on Jun 19, 2006 and is issued by ProShares.

holdings.infoBox: MVV is an equity ETF with a total of 412 individual holdings. The top holdings are Cash stock at 9.97%, S&P Midcap 400 Index Swap at 5.79%, ProShares GENIUS Money Market ETF at 3.56%, U.S. Dollar For Futures at 2.56%, and Cte ? Proshares Trust M at 1.20%.
